messages:
maria: Quick question — I noticed some clients crash when 'metadata' is omitted vs when it's present as null in /v2/generate responses. Do we have an official field-presence contract? Need a short decision so SDKs and docs can be consistent. cc @evan @sarah

evan: We don't have a single canonical doc yet. My preference: treat omission as 'not provided' and null as 'explicitly null'. But that can be awkward across languages. Proposal: (1) publish a tiny 'field-presence' guidance in the OpenAPI, (2) add canonical example responses, (3) SDK generators map absent->undefined/None and null->null.

sarah: +1 to Evan's flow. One operational note: metadata landed last quarter and likely has few consumers — we could run a canary that flips semantics for a small % to measure breakage before any global change.

kevin: Suggestion: what about an opt-in request header (X-Preserve-Fields: true) so clients can choose the legacy behavior? Less risky than global toggles.

maria: I'd rather avoid request-level headers if we can — ops surface area and support overhead go up. Canary + SDK updates are simpler.

ci-bot: RFC posted: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/2024/field-presence_guidance — example OpenAPI snippet in the draft:
```
components:
  schemas:
    GenerateResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        metadata:
          nullable: true
          description: "Optional metadata; if omitted, treat as not-provided. Clients must handle both omitted and null.

          When adding new optional objects, prefer omission for unknown older clients."
```

evan: For SDKs I'll add explicit mapping rules in the generator: TypeScript -> `metadata?: Metadata | null`; Python -> `Optional[dict] = None`. Also adding a runtime shim in the fetch layer to normalize absent->undefined for JS clients, and a dev-only console warning when null vs absent differs.

sarah: :thumbsup: I'll draft the OpenAPI PR + update example responses. Can someone from QA own the canary validation? @kevin?

kevin: I'll spin up a staging canary and a prod 1% toggle tomorrow AM. Will add metrics for error rate and SDK client telemetry.

maria: Great. Action items: @sarah open OpenAPI + examples PR; @evan update SDK generator mapping; @kevin run canary and report; QA to run integration tests against both shapes. I'll also ping Docs to add a short 'Field presence' note. Closing unless objections.

sarah: Small follow-up — should we add a short example in the SDK changelog showing how to handle both cases? I'm happy to add that to the PR.

maria: Yes please, that would be helpful. Thanks all!
